summary: Cycle 19 of Phase 5 (suppression audit), the sole remaining open workstream on this task. Repo-wide blanket suppression lines (ratchet-tracked): 165 -> 155 (10 fewer). A live per-file upstream/local-only split (git cat-file -e upstream/main:<path>, filtered to fs > 0 files) found 155 total = 141 local-only in-scope (71 files) + 14 upstream-carved-out (unchanged). Plan updated throughout (RESUME HERE, Phase 5 header, Phase 5 cycle-19 entry with the full 2-file breakdown and two new findings, 'pick up cold' instructions). Full CSLib CI pipeline re-run at cycle end and confirmed green: lake build --wfail --iofail exactly 5 baseline sorry warnings (zero new, matching the documented baseline), checkInitImports clean, lint-style clean, lake shake exactly the 12 upstream-shared files (zero local-only findings), mk_all no update necessary, lake test exit 0 (same 5 baseline sorry warnings plus the one pre-existing backward.privateInPublic warning in CslibTests/FreeMonad.lean). True sorry census via the comment-stripped method: 28, unchanged. Axiom count unchanged at 26. Vacuous-def grep unchanged at the single pre-existing false positive. git diff on both of this cycle's commits individually confirmed zero sorry lines touched. decisions_made: Per the delegation's continuation note, started with Separation/Hierarchy/HierarchyDefs.lean (the count-4 tier's sole remaining file) before moving into the count-6 tier smaller-first, picking FrameClassVariants.lean (931 lines, the smallest of the 5 count-6 files at cycle 18's close) next.

For HierarchyDefs.lean's 24 linter.flexible warnings, used a mixed strategy: manually reconstructed simp only [...] for the 6 sites matching the well-understood isUFree/isSFree Bool.and_eq_true unfold pattern, and used declaration-scoped set_option linter.flexible false in (a repo-precedented, safe narrowing) for the remaining 18 sites whose simp calls modify multi-step goals/hypotheses in ways a manual simp-only reconstruction risked getting subtly wrong.

For FrameClassVariants.lean's 38 unusedSimpArgs warnings, collected every warning per simp-only line before editing (several lines had 2-3 flagged unused args reported one at a time in separate warning blocks) and applied the fully-reduced argument list in a single edit per line, using replace_all only where every occurrence of an identical simp-only string in the file was independently confirmed flagged.

For FrameClassVariants.lean's 4 linter.flexible sites, matched the Function.iterate_succ/Function.comp_apply pattern the build log's own 'Try this' hint suggested for a structurally identical site elsewhere in the same file, then verified by rebuild before trusting it (per the cycle-18 caution against pasting suggestions blind).

Did not touch the remaining count-6 tier files (RecursiveWalks.lean, MainElimination.lean, Interface.lean, ChronicleToCountermodelBasic.lean) this cycle, stopping after 2 files to leave adequate budget for full CI re-verification and an accurate plan/handoff update given FrameClassVariants.lean's unusually high 61-warning count consumed more of the cycle than typical.

New findings this cycle: (1) when several unusedSimpArgs warnings flag different unused arguments on the same simp-only line, collect every warning for that line before editing -- each one's Hint only removes the one argument it names, so editing off a single warning can leave a now-also-unused argument the next warning would have flagged; (2) declaration-scoped set_option linter.flexible false in (94 pre-existing repo-wide uses before this cycle) is a safe, sanctioned narrowing for linter.flexible sites whose simp interacts with multi-step reductions too risky to manually reconstruct -- prefer manual simp only reconstruction only when the pattern is simple and well-understood (a single Bool-and unfold, or an existing 'Try this' hint elsewhere in the same file that rebuild-verifies cleanly). Also carried forward: (a) the cycle-18 caution that the linter.flexible 'Try this: simp only [...]' suggestion can omit def-unfold lemmas -- always verify by rebuild before trusting it; (b) a file whose style.openClassical suppression targets a persistent non-`in` open Classical correctly bottoms out at 1 remaining blanket line, not 0; (c) lake lint's unusedArguments findings (out-of-scope linter) -- do not fix opportunistically; (d) when re-deriving the worst-offender list, filter to fs > 0 before the upstream gate.
